name: Sabudana
description: Translucent starch pearls soaked till they swell — the vrat khichdi staple.

tcm.note: Read with the starches; neutral and spleen-strengthening.

ayurveda.note: Shita and guru — pure starch, and the reason it is permitted on fasting days.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; heavy and filling, easy on a fasting stomach.

histamine.note: Very low — nearly pure starch, and among the safest things on a reactive day.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
